notes.title: D.M.Y. 03.01.2019 - 1.0.3.1. Bug fix and some tweaks
notes.notes: Happy new year to whoever you are. I have just fixed the game again. Yes there was anooother problem ːsteamfacepalmː . The game was acting all weird when you [Alt][Tab]-ed out and came back only to find that the pellets did not load and the maze was not updating. But now, there is a solution.  Rand-O-mazE now will halt and wait for you to return to the application before continuing. Thank you to RazgrizSF for finding that bug. I also made a few little adjustments to the menu and fonts. I hope your having a great 2019.. Cheers Dev

notes.title: D.M.Y 15.11.2015 - Update - 1.0.2.2 - Deadzone increase
notes.notes:
Hey again,

Rand-O-mazE - UpdateVersion 1.0.2.2 
Dead-zone increased to 33% - Hopefully this should reduce movement issues for some controllers - Thank you supersmo for suggesting this improvement.

Also, Can someone tell me, does steam tell you to update the file automatically? If it does then just update it. Otherwise uninstall and reinstall Rand-O-mazE to get this update. And it is always worth having the latest version..

Just as some of the human race seem to be evolving back into something like a chimpanzee (knuckles dragging on the ground and no social grace) so to does Rand-O-mazE (but the other way). So if there are any more bugs or suggested improvements please put it into a discussion and I will work on it.

Cheers - dev - sublemonal_au

notes.title: 12.11.2018 1.0.2.1 XBox 360 Controller Bug fix is now live
notes.notes:
Hello Person reading this,

1.0.2.1 - Bug Fix - For some reason the Xbox 360 controller inputs changed from one thing to another. I have updated Rand-O-mazE to map the buttons correctly and increased the deadzone for the XBox 360 wired controller. I don't know what caused the issue. Maybe it was the recent update to Allegro 5.2.4.1 or maybe something else. I dunno. But its fixed now. Thank you to supersmo for finding that one.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.2 - 3.11.2018
notes.notes:
Rand-O-mazE Updates And Info (Releases, Updates & Bug Fixes - Dates in D.M.Y format)

This is where you can find info regarding the latest release v1.0.1.2 - To update to the current release from the steam client, first uninstall then reinstall Rand-O-mazE.

If you have any problems with Rand-O-mazE, start a discussion so the world can see. I will work as quick as I can to fix the problem. 

Thanks for your support and I hope you enjoy the game - Cheers Dev ( sublemonal_au )

Release Info: 

3.11.2018 - 1.0.1.2 - Bug Fix - The last Bug Fix didn't actually fix the issue, so I had to approach the problem differently. Should be better. If your version is exiting on the first run, reinstall it and it should run first go now.

1.11.2018 - 1.0.1.1 - Bug Fix - The recent minor Improvement re-querying the steam leader board caused the game to terminate for some reason. I have added a 10 second delay to allow the steam callbacks time to do their stuff. Hopefully this fixes the problem.

31.10.2018 - 1.0.1.0 - Minor Improvements 
- Improved Keyboard Mode - WASD is better? Personally I use the arrows. But hey, I added it (for the lefties).
- No more [unknown] steam users in leaderboards. Rand-O-mazE will requery steam until they become known..

28.10.2018 - 1.0.0.2 is live - Display Bug Fix - There was a issue causing the display to not be visible in part on some systems, chopping off the top and botton of the display and only rendering the center part to a height of 480 pixels. I think this issue is now fixed but if it is still a problem please let me know. Thank you to The Retro Viking for finding that.

26.10.2018 - 1.0.0.1 is live - Menu bug fix is now live - If you have any issues with menu displaying correctly, especially with big monitors, please uninstall and reinstall Rand-O-mazE. Thank you to Colossus for finding that.

26.10.2018 - Rand-O-mazE is live - 1.0.0.0 for Windows now on Steam
